FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
MAWANELLA PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS, the office of a member in Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of removal of member;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance, to whichthe Former member P. P. Wickramasinha belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaid Ordinance, tonominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the Ordinance for Election as a member of that MawanellaPradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Haputhenne ViyannalageVasantha Sumith Priyalal Weragoda being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy :

NOW THEREFORE I, Gamalathge Dilip Nishantha, Returning Officer of Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha, acting interms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Haputhenne Viyannalage Vasantha SumithPriyalal Weragoda elected as a member of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
GAMALATHGE DILIP NISHANTHA,
Returning Officer,Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Kegalle,27th November, 2014.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN OF THE
MAWANELLA PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (1) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS, the office of Chairman in Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of removal of Chairman;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United People's Freedom Alliance the recognized political party, to which P.P. Wickramasinha the Former Chairman belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(1) of the aforesaid Ordinance, todecide upon the Chairman of that Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall be declared electedas Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Mr. D. M. Kirthi Bandara Thilaka to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Gamalathge Dilip Nishantha, Returning Officer of Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha, acting interms of Section 65A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr.D. M. Kirthi Bandara Thilaka elected asChairman of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
GAMALATHGE DILIP NISHANTHA,
Returning Officer,Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Kegalle,27th November, 2014.
